name: LaBeau's Classic Cheeseburger, Pastrami Burger, or Chicken Strips Basket
whyItWorks: Classic drive-in burger on a soft white bun is low-fiber when ordered plain without raw onions or fry sauce overload.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Single Cheeseburger on a white bun (meat, cheese, bun only) and go easy on the deep-fried french fries, tater tots, or onion rings.
watchOuts: Skip deep-fried onion rings and heavy pastrami fat during flares
